## Data Viz

::: {.project-card}
### Income inequality before and after taxes

How do pre-tax and post-tax income inequality compare across countries in 2020? This analysis uses data shared through TidyTuesday and a scatterplot made in R.

[Read the analysis →](income-inequality.qmd)
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Big Tech stock prices in 2022

How did Apple and Microsoft's adjusted closing stock prices change during 2022? This analysis compares their daily prices with a line graph.

[Read the analysis →](big-tech-stock-prices.qmd)
:::

## About this project

This site is made with Quarto and R for Foundations of Data Science. The source files, including the `.qmd` pages and rendered website, are in the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/aarya28-tech/aarya28-tech.github.io).
:::
